business_summary.text: Bank of India is a public sector bank with global business of ₹17.55 lakh crore at June 2026, spanning domestic retail, agriculture, MSME and corporate lending plus an international book of about ₹2.56 lakh crore.

lab.quote: Against this backdrop, our guidance for FY27 is - global advances to grow by 15-16%, and global deposits by 16-17%.

call_memory.quote: Against this backdrop, our guidance for FY27 is - global advances to grow by 15-16%, and global deposits by 16-17%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Global advances are guided to grow by 15-16% in FY27.

lab.quote: Against this backdrop, our guidance for FY27 is - global advances to grow by 15-16%, and global deposits by 16-17%.

call_memory.quote: Against this backdrop, our guidance for FY27 is - global advances to grow by 15-16%, and global deposits by 16-17%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Global deposits are guided to grow by 16-17% in FY27.

lab.quote: Our endeavour that we will have ROA of above 1% in the ensuing quarters also and the overall March ’27, that we’ll be showing ROA of above 1%.

call_memory.quote: Our endeavour that we will have ROA of above 1% in the ensuing quarters also and the overall March ’27, that we’ll be showing ROA of above 1%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The bank aims to maintain a Return on Assets above 1% for FY27.

lab.quote: and with this run rate, we should have a profit of around Rs. 12,000 crores in this financial year.

call_memory.quote: and with this run rate, we should have a profit of around Rs. 12,000 crores in this financial year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The bank expects full year net profit to reach around Rs. 12,000 crores in FY27.

lab.quote: So, this increase in the repo rate will also, help the bank in improvement in the NIM by around 6 to 7 basis points.

call_memory.quote: So, this increase in the repo rate will also, help the bank in improvement in the NIM by around 6 to 7 basis points.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The repo rate hike passed on is expected to improve NIM by around 6 to 7 basis points.

lab.quote: So, as far as the pipeline is concerned on the credit side, let me tell that as far as the corporate pipeline is concerned, as on 30th September, we are having a pipeline of around Rs. 65,000 crores.

call_memory.quote: So, as far as the pipeline is concerned on the credit side, let me tell that as far as the corporate pipeline is concerned, as on 30th September, we are having a pipeline of around Rs. 65,000 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Corporate credit pipeline stands at around Rs. 65,000 crores as of September 30, 2026.

lab.quote: Apart from that, in the RAM side also, we have a pipeline of around Rs. 20,000 crores.

call_memory.quote: Apart from that, in the RAM side also, we have a pipeline of around Rs. 20,000 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: RAM credit pipeline stands at around Rs. 20,000 crores as of September 30, 2026.

lab.quote: And then we also have created pipeline in the pool and co-lending and the supply chain platform which is around Rs. 4,000 crores.

call_memory.quote: And then we also have created pipeline in the pool and co-lending and the supply chain platform which is around Rs. 4,000 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Pool, co-lending and supply chain pipeline stands at around Rs. 4,000 crores as of September 30, 2026.

lab.quote: And if I give you a sense on the corporate credit side, the main numbers are from renewable energy of more than Rs.12,000 crores, in which we have sanctioned and yet to be disbursed, or in principle approval is given and the proposal is under different stages of being placed to the committee.

call_memory.quote: And if I give you a sense on the corporate credit side, the main numbers are from renewable energy of more than Rs.12,000 crores, in which we have sanctioned and yet to be disbursed, or in principle approval is given and the proposal is under different stages of being placed to the committee.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Renewable energy corporate pipeline stands at more than Rs. 12,000 crores.

lab.quote: In power sector, we have more than Rs. 9,000 crores pipeline, in road sector, again we have more than Rs. 5,000 crore, in Oil and gas, we have more than Rs. 5,000 crore, in Cement in which again more than Rs. 4,000 crore, in Manufacturing, particularly with the textile and others, we have more than Rs. 2,700 crore, in Construction Rs. 2,100 crore, in Automobiles also more than Rs. 2,000.

call_memory.quote: In power sector, we have more than Rs. 9,000 crores pipeline, in road sector, again we have more than Rs. 5,000 crore, in Oil and gas, we have more than Rs. 5,000 crore, in Cement in which again more than Rs. 4,000 crore, in Manufacturing, particularly with the textile and others, we have more than Rs. 2,700 crore, in Construction Rs. 2,100 crore, in Automobiles also more than Rs. 2,000.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Power sector corporate pipeline is more than Rs. 9,000 crores.

lab.quote: But the ballpark number on the impact on the CRAR side, somewhere around 0.5%, on an annual basis in the next 4 years.

call_memory.quote: But the ballpark number on the impact on the CRAR side, somewhere around 0.5%, on an annual basis in the next 4 years.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: ECL implementation is estimated to have a ballpark impact on CRAR of around 0.5% annually over the next 4 years.

lab.quote: So, we expect that from Q3 onwards we will be making the provisions. Q3 and Q4 will be the 2 quarters when we should be making the front loading of the provisions as far as the ECL is concerned.

call_memory.quote: So, we expect that from Q3 onwards we will be making the provisions. Q3 and Q4 will be the 2 quarters when we should be making the front loading of the provisions as far as the ECL is concerned.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bank of India will begin front-loading ECL provisions starting from Q3 FY27.

lab.quote: So, that impact on this Rs. 40,000 crores is around 5 basis points. That is the impact which has happened in the global NIM. So, this 5 basis point impact is because of the FCNR which is there.

call_memory.quote: So, that impact on this Rs. 40,000 crores is around 5 basis points. That is the impact which has happened in the global NIM. So, this 5 basis point impact is because of the FCNR which is there.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Raising $2.2 billion in FCNR deposits and placing them in international book reduced global NIM by 5 basis points.

lab.quote: If you see our presentation also, 66% of our domestic advances are external benchmark-linked, which is repo only.

call_memory.quote: If you see our presentation also, 66% of our domestic advances are external benchmark-linked, which is repo only.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: 66% of domestic advances are linked to external benchmarks (repo-linked).

lab.quote: But as you rightly said, that impact will be staggered because, as you are aware, that nearly 60% of our term deposits are in the category of 1 year to 18 months.

call_memory.quote: But as you rightly said, that impact will be staggered because, as you are aware, that nearly 60% of our term deposits are in the category of 1 year to 18 months.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Nearly 60% of term deposits fall in the maturity bracket of 1 year to 18 months.

lab.quote: That is one of the major components where Rs. 213 crores have been reversed in this quarter.

call_memory.quote: That is one of the major components where Rs. 213 crores have been reversed in this quarter.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Provisions on standard assets were reversed by Rs. 213 crores in Q2 FY27 due to an account exiting SMA.

lab.quote: If you go to our slide number 25, you will see that for SMA Rs. 5 crores and above, we have reduced that number now to Rs. 2,553 crores as against Rs. 6,000 plus crores as on September 30,2026.

call_memory.quote: If you go to our slide number 25, you will see that for SMA Rs. 5 crores and above, we have reduced that number now to Rs. 2,553 crores as against Rs. 6,000 plus crores as on September 30,2026.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: SMA accounts of Rs. 5 crore and above reduced to Rs. 2,553 crores, representing 0.3% of standard advances as of September 30, 2026.

lab.quote: So, as far as the gold loan outstanding as on 30th September is concerned, we are having a gold loan book of around Rs. 61,000 crores.

call_memory.quote: So, as far as the gold loan outstanding as on 30th September is concerned, we are having a gold loan book of around Rs. 61,000 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The gold loan portfolio stood at around Rs. 61,000 crores as of September 30, 2026.

lab.quote: So, we are expecting that we want to maintain this kind of run rate during the entire year.

call_memory.quote: So, we are expecting that we want to maintain this kind of run rate during the entire year.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The bank targets a sustainable quarterly run-rate of around Rs. 900 crores in recovery from written-off accounts during the year.

lab.quote: We are 73.8%, so that we are already complied. So, at present, we have no indication from the government to further reduce this number. We don’t have any plan also as on date for raising any capital.

call_memory.quote: We are 73.8%, so that we are already complied. So, at present, we have no indication from the government to further reduce this number. We don’t have any plan also as on date for raising any capital.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The bank has no plan as on date for raising any capital as government shareholding is at 73.8%.

lab.quote: Our unsecured portfolio is very less. It’s hardly 7% of the total portfolio in retail.

call_memory.quote: Our unsecured portfolio is very less. It’s hardly 7% of the total portfolio in retail.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Unsecured portfolio accounts for hardly 7% of the total retail loan book.

lab.quote: and we are very confident that by the year end, when this branch stabilizes under this supply chain financing, we should be having business of somewhere around Rs. 1,500 crore in the first year itself.

call_memory.quote: and we are very confident that by the year end, when this branch stabilizes under this supply chain financing, we should be having business of somewhere around Rs. 1,500 crore in the first year itself.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bank expects the centralized supply chain financing branch in Mumbai to achieve Rs. 1,500 crore in business by the year end.

timeline.summary: Bank of India announced an unchanged MCLR and RBLR alongside a revision in Fixed Rate Spread effective May 1, 2026.

Bank of India reported Q4 FY26 consolidated net profit of ₹3,016 Cr with global advances growing 15.82% YoY on May 8, 2026.
Bank of India held a virtual earnings conference call on May 8, 2026, discussing Q4 FY 2025-26 results with analysts and investors from 7:00 PM to 8:25 PM.
Bank of India infused ₹22.64 crore into associate ASREC (India) Limited, raising its stake to 27.30%.
Bank of India reported Q4 FY26 net profit of ₹3,016 Cr with global advances growing 15.82% YoY on May 8, 2026.

Bank of India’s Vice President—Listing held a one-to-one virtual meeting with M/s. Balyasny on 2026-06-03, sharing only publicly available information.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for dividend at AGM

watchlist.response: Said majority of the $200 million raised so far is core FCNR with little leverage, but declined to quantify the leverage spread, calling it a moving target.
watchlist.text: Sushil Choksey asked what portion of the $1.2 billion FCNR target would be leveraged versus direct deposits, and what spread the leverage carries.

watchlist.response: Said PSL income opportunity exists in Q2 and Q3 but gave no number; said there are no plans for an AS15 reversal.
watchlist.text: Lavish (Morgan Stanley) asked how PSL income would trend after ₹277 Cr in Q1 and whether an AS15 provision reversal was planned.

watchlist.response: Gave ROA 1%+, NIM 2.55–2.60% and CIR 48–49% for FY27, implying the Q1 cost ratio is not expected to repeat.
watchlist.text: Nitin (Aurum Capital) asked for FY27 guidance on ROA, NIM and cost to income and whether 2.52% NIM and 46.3% CIR can be held in Q2.

watchlist.response: Attributed it to a structural shift in savings into equities and mutual funds, plus bulk deposits taken to fund credit growth, offset by cheaper 3–25 Cr fixed deposits.
watchlist.text: Sharad Chandra asked why CASA and retail term deposit shares each fell about 3% while cost of deposits still fell 15 bps.
